basics.name: Diego E. Salazar
basics.label: Staff / Principal Software Engineer · AI products & full-stack platforms · Former VP of Engineering
basics.tagline: I build reliable products, simplify complex systems, and help engineering teams deliver.
summary: I'm a software engineer and former VP of Engineering with approximately 20 years of experience building for the web and beyond. I work across AI products, full-stack platforms, system design, and engineering leadership, from the user interface to the infrastructure underneath it.

At Sony Music, I cut sales-matching processing from over 90 minutes to under 30, reduced team AWS costs by over 20%, and established engineering standards for a five-engineer team. At Bloomberg Law, I directed technical delivery of approximately six AI features for legal document workflows, partnering with legal experts and data scientists to evaluate their quality.

Earlier, as VP of Engineering at Kipu Health, I grew the engineering organization from 3 to 20 engineers as the company expanded to more than 1,000 treatment facilities. I still enjoy hands-on engineering: untangling coupled systems, choosing pragmatic architectures, and making the team around me faster. I also build open-source AI tooling, mentor developers, and speak English and Spanish.
basics.availability: Open to Staff / Principal engineering opportunities

work.name: Sony Music Entertainment
work.summary: Designed full-stack systems and improved data processing, cloud costs, and engineering practices for a five-engineer team.
highlights: Re-architected sales matching for gigabyte- to terabyte-scale datasets, cutting processing time from over 90 minutes to under 30 minutes.
Reduced team AWS infrastructure costs by over 20%.
Cut average merge time from 1.5 days to 0.5 days (approximately 67%); led design reviews and established engineering standards.
Consolidated coupled codebases into monorepos and related services into transactional boundaries to enable ACID guarantees and simplify collaboration.
Designed full-stack systems using React, ECS, Lambda and Aurora; codified infrastructure in Terraform and deployed through Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
work.stack: TypeScript, Python (typed, mypy), React, Bash, HTML/CSS, AWS (ECS, Lambda, Aurora MySQL/MariaDB), Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions

work.name: Bloomberg Law
work.summary: Directed technical delivery of AI-powered legal document features within a product engineering team of about 10, including two data scientists.
highlights: Shipped approximately six AI features across a web file-management application and Word and Outlook add-ins for selected law firms.
Partnered with legal experts to create gold-standard datasets of hundreds of human-labeled documents, maintaining F-scores above 0.95 on ML classification and extraction tasks.
Implemented streaming and chunking for a production document corpus spanning hundreds of GB; achieved time to first token under 5 seconds and complete analysis under 10 seconds for select features.

Architected serverless applications with API Gateway, Lambda, React, Vue, CloudFront and S3; migrated Rails-rendered pages to a Vue SPA and JSON API, enabling independent frontend releases and daily deployments.
Mentored interns and interviewed approximately one engineering candidate per month throughout my tenure.
work.stack: TypeScript, React, Vue, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Java, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS

work.name: Kipu Health
work.summary: Led engineering at a healthcare SaaS company, setting technical direction and building the teams and practices that supported its growth.
highlights: Grew the engineering organization from 3 to 20 direct reports as the company expanded from a few dozen to over 1,000 treatment facilities.
Established dedicated DevOps, IT support and full-stack product teams; defined technical roadmaps, engineering standards, hiring and technical screening processes.
Architected a fault-tolerant asynchronous public API for hospital integrations and inter-clinic record sharing, and served as lead architect for appointment management.
Introduced automated testing and CI/CD, doubling release frequency from every two weeks to weekly.
Established remote-work policies and collaboration tooling; oversaw onboarding, code reviews and pair programming.
